# {{ site.author }}

> {{ site.job_title }} at {{ site.organization.name }}. {{ site.description }}

{% assign profile_page = site.pages | where: 'url', '/' | first -%}
{{ profile_page.content | strip_html | strip }}

The publication collection is a committed snapshot. Its JSON contains `records` with bibliographic metadata, `clusters` with generated topic labels, and `meta` with the build time and dataset provenance. Citation counts reflect the source snapshot; the graph build time is not the date of a new Scholar scrape. Interactive List and Map views require JavaScript; the JSON can be read directly.

## Profile

- [Personal site]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Bio and professional profile links.
- [Curriculum vitae]({{ site.cv_pdf | absolute_url }}): Public CV in PDF format.
- [University profile]({{ site.cmu_profile }}): Faculty profile at {{ site.organization.name }}.

## Publications

- [Publication metadata]({{ '/assets/json/pubs.json' | absolute_url }}): Structured publication records, available abstracts and source links, citation counts, map coordinates, and provenance.
- [Publication browser]({{ '/?view=list' | absolute_url }}): Searchable list with paper details and links; also offers an interactive topic map.
- [Map downloads]({{ '/assets/maps/' | absolute_url }}): Publication maps sized for social media and slides, with PNGs, scalable SVGs, and snapshot provenance.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user={{ site.google_scholar }}): Scholar profile and publication records.
- [Source dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ccm/publications): Upstream publication metadata and embeddings used to build the site's snapshot.

## Optional

- [Website repository](https://github.com/{{ site.github }}/cmccomb.github.io): Source code and guides for site development, data processing, and maintenance.
